steps: launch release bundle from a cold process
wait for the app shell and settings/auth restore to settle
capture startup footprint and first usable paint
terminate the app and verify all child processes exit
leave the release app visible with no active playback
capture CPU, threads, footprint and runtime diagnostics
repeat after the warmup window without user interaction
search, open a detail page, navigate back and restore scroll
create a queue, use play-next and change repeat/shuffle/reverse
change volume and seek while observing state and error handling
open lyrics with word timing and translation/romanization
capture native-display-rate active-line, word-fill and scroll-spring traces with a 120 Hz target
exercise wheel, touch, hover, context menu and reduced-motion
launch the exact release bundle with keychain and account restore disabled
visit and fully scroll at least 50 deterministic offline artist fixtures through similar-artist DFS edges
return to the normal /daily/songs home route and play the verified local Range audio fixture
sample WebContent, main, GPU and Networking physical footprint plus RSS once per second through DFS and at least 600 seconds of recovery
record image load/error/reload/blank and active-request telemetry, native-display frame intervals, peak footprint, stable footprint and recovery slope
load remote and managed cache sources
test pause/resume, seek markers, ended, repeat and rapid replacement
test volume, MediaSession and output-device fallback
play audio while lyrics animation and background are visible
capture synchronized progress, active-line and scroll traces
compare CPU, frame time, WebContent and GPU footprint
run ordinary playback and lyrics for 60 minutes
sample after GC opportunities and record diagnostic counter slopes
verify leases, requests, timers, listeners and child processes at exit
repeat lyrics, MV, route, login and playback enter/exit flows 30 times
capture DOM, listener, timer, media, lease and request counts per cycle
require post-cycle steady state to match the pre-cycle baseline
